references.title: 勞動基準法 §24(1): 延長工作時間在二小時以內者，按平日每小時工資額加給三分之一以上；再延長工作時間在二小時以內者，加給三分之二以上 — each working day’s overtime: the time recorded past the planned shift’s hours in completed half-hours, less any banked as 補休 (work.days[].overtime_hours), the first two at 1.34 and every further hour at 1.67 of the hourly wage (monthly wage incl. regular allowances ÷ 30 ÷ 8). §24(1)(3): 依第三十二條第四項規定，延長工作時間者，按平日每小時工資額加倍發給 — not priced: no roster fact marks a §32(4) day in work.days. Within the §32 limits it is not taxable salary (所得稅法 §14(1)(3)).

description: Normal working-day overtime hours, paid at the statutory multiplier.

references.title: 勞動基準法 §40(1): 因天災、事變或突發事件…停止第三十六條至第三十八條所定勞工之假期。但停止假期之工資，應加倍發給，並應於事後補假休息 — one further day’s wage for each worked day whose shift is REST (the §36 例假); the rest in lieu is STATUTORY_REST_IN_LIEU. Work on a 例假 outside §40 is unlawful but its wage is still owed.

description: Hours worked on the statutory weekly rest day, paid at the rest-day multiplier.

references.title: 勞動基準法 §24(2): 雇主使勞工於第三十六條所定休息日工作，工作時間在二小時以內者，其工資按平日每小時工資額另再加給一又三分之一以上；工作二小時後再繼續工作者，按平日每小時工資額另再加給一又三分之二以上 — the statute has two tiers only, so every hour after the second is 1.67, the ninth to twelfth included (owner decision 2026-11-06). Priced on the hours actually worked — all of the day’s recorded time in completed half-hours, less any banked as 補休, counted from the first hour (the minimum-count rule was deleted 2018-03-01) on a day whose shift is OFF, the TW 休息日 (shift_definition.variant.day_type OFF; REST is the §36 例假).

description: Hours worked on a rest day, paid at the statutory rest-day multiplier.

references.title: 勞動基準法 §39: 休假日…工作者，工資應加倍發給 — one further day’s wage (monthly wage ÷ 30) for each published holiday actually worked; a holiday not worked is already in the monthly salary. 改制前勞委會 87年9月14日(87)台勞動二字第039675號函: hours beyond eight follow §24 (HOLIDAY_OVERTIME).

description: Hours worked on a statutory holiday, paid at the statutory holiday multiplier.

references.title: 勞動基準法 §39 with §24(1): paid hours on a holiday beyond the eighth and past the planned shift (on a planned rest or off day, every recorded hour after the eighth), less any banked as 補休, at 1.34 for the first two and 1.67 after (改制前勞委會 87年9月14日(87)台勞動二字第039675號函; 高雄市勞工局 115年休假日一覽表 附註三). They count toward the §32 monthly overtime ceiling.

description: Overtime hours worked on a statutory holiday, paid at the holiday-overtime multiplier.
